purpose: (1) DOS 96/48 -> 384/192 recalibration of the three final configurations (one converged run per film; mu_band pre-scaled by 1/1.025 from the 2 nm run_0029 offset, then rescaled EXACTLY by Ion_meas/Ion_sim - Id is linear in a constant mobility); (2) PROSPECTIVE predictions recorded before any measurement: ID-VD families (Vg = 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3 V; Vd 0-3 V) and transfer curves at 65 C (338.15 K, 2 nm) and 85 C (358.15 K, all films) - the temperatures of the Januar SI Fig. S12 elevated-temperature transfer curves of the 2 nm device, which are NOT in our possession (prediction recorded before we see them) with the recalibrated parameters; (3) parameter-isolation tests: gate work function +0.1 eV alone and m* x1.3 alone at 2 and 13.2 nm, relative to the B1/B3 baselines (same mu).
